method: Recomputed from source each run rather than incremented. Daily lines are deduped by (date,bot) keeping the last filing, which drops superseded re-filings so a session is never counted twice; trade_event lines are all kept.
note: 'hype_sentiment' is now decisively the worst driver in the ledger and it produced BOTH of this run's large losses: sentiment -60.95 on an NVDA buy placed 1.1% under the day's high, and hypecrypto -102.73 on a PROM buy placed into a six-day 117% run. The two bots share one defect, an entry rule with no price filter, so they pay whatever the euphoria scan names at the moment it names it. Against that, the real-money lottery book took a breakout entry the same day on a 24h-low distance test and is up 17.1%, which is the cleanest controlled comparison the fleet has produced. 'market_beta' lines dominate the honest-and-boring end: four books were 100% in one asset and simply returned it.
